headline: **MLB Recap: Top Performances and Roster Moves**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nick Gonzales leading the offense. Gonzales hit a home run and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI. The Cincinnati Reds defeated the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Julio Rodríguez has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Cooper Criswell was transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. Ryan Helsley was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 30 with right elbow discomfort. Bennett Sousa was transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen. The Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nick Gonzales leading the offense. Gonzales hit a home run (4) on a fly ball to left center field and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 10-run victory. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, coming out on top in a closely contested game. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs, while Daniel Espino pitched 1.2 scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Julio Rodríguez Placed on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners center fielder Julio Rodríguez has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. Nicolas is now set to join the Nationals' roster.
